clm_7535f3ac78.text: Dijkstra with a binary heap runs in O((V+E) log V) on graphs with non-negative weights.
clm_7535f3ac78.notes: asymptotic result; says nothing about constant factors at the tested sizes

clm_97597f457d.text: Bellman-Ford runs in O(V*E) and tolerates negative weights, which are not present in this benchmark.
clm_97597f457d.notes: asymptotic result; says nothing about constant factors at the tested sizes

clm_268917d5f1.text: Breadth-first search computes shortest paths only when every edge weight is equal.
clm_268917d5f1.notes: asymptotic result; says nothing about constant factors at the tested sizes
